content:
Welcome back! I remember our previous conversations.

How can I help you today?
List me all you can fetch for me related to my session

Sure! Here’s what I can fetch for you related to your MCL session:

1. Your profile information (full name, email, company name, and role).
2. The markets assigned to you.
3. The checklists available to you, including any pending ones.
4. The number of open tasks assigned to you.
5. The checklist questions configured for your company.
6. The departments configured for your company.
7. The mapping of departments to markets/stores within your company.
8. The data services/datasets your app syncs.
9. The notification email recipients configured for your company.
10. A full sync snapshot of your data and company configuration.
11. The users available for task assignment in your company.
12. Your current MCL tasks, including tasks created via this assistant.

Let me know if you’d like to dig into any of these!
Fetch each one and give me the information  pls
